purpose: Resident routes V2: relocate the people-v3 loops that were authored inside hollow architecture shells (inner-court supporting platform, cell plinths, west terrace steps, corner kitchens) as measured in real-RHI PIE, in BOTH the main 50 cm directory (people.json) and the isolated 48 cm candidate directory (people-candidate48.json). Roles, dialogue, missions, pauses, labels, actions, laps and gaze anchors are unchanged; only waypoint X/Y move, in legacy50 source centimetres. The pilgrim placement envelope is corrected to exclude the shells. Offline plan() checks every waypoint and every 25 cm leg sample against the manifest's constituent boxes (unions decomposed, never a whole-part AABB) at both scales. Native apply stages the files, repoints a population actor only if needed, checkpoints and saves only when the map changed. The PIE verify mode reports walking/skipped, blocked legs and actual motion per resident. Nothing here is a halachic ruling, an access policy or visual acceptance.

pilgrimEnvelope.decision: Pilgrims stand and walk on the outer court floor (Z 300, x 1500..7000, 900 <= |y| < 6000, legacy 50 cm source centimetres), off the y=0 east gate corridor, and OUTSIDE the hollow architecture shells that stand on that floor: the raised inner-court supporting platform (|x| and |y| <= 2800), the inner east cell plinths (x 2800..3600, 375 <= |y| <= 2275), the north and south cell plinth overhangs (x 375..2275, 2800 <= |y| <= 3600), the west terrace steps and foundation (x <= 1675) and the corner kitchen courts (x >= 5300, |y| >= 5400). Every waypoint and leg keeps the 34 cm capsule radius clear of those footprints at either amah scale; the earlier envelope wrongly treated the platform and plinth area as open floor (PIE receipt spawn-diagnosis-20260908T184544564223Z). This repeats the reviewed pilot envelope rather than opening new ground.
